title.narrative: Support for the application of the Central American System of Recognition, Validation and Accreditation of foundational or basic skills test

description.narrative: In order to support the right to education of youth and adults who have not finalized the 9th grade of the formal education cycle, which is considered the basic education level to be considered for a job in the SICA region, the Education and Culture Coordination of the SICA region (CECC-SICA) requested UNESCO San Jose to work support in the application of 9th grade assessments on math and language (reading and writing) in El Salvador, Guatemala and Honduras, in collaboration with Ministries of Education of selected countries and grass-roots NGOs. The tests will facilitate youth and adults that did not take formal tests to certify their skills, and in the case they don´t pass, the project will provide authorities with focalized flexible education strategies to continue their education and obtain the needed certification.
